name: dsh-my-workspace
description: Workspace quick actions for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: open the current session's project root in any detected IDE (VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains…), a native terminal, or the system file manager, copy its path with one click, and run shell commands in a header-unfolded quick terminal (close stops them; trailing & backgrounds them). Bilingual (English/中文) UI. 工作区快捷操作：把当前会话的项目根目录一键在检测到的 IDE（VS Code、Cursor、JetBrains…）、原生终端或系统文件管理器中打开，并一键复制路径；页头 >_ 展开快捷终端就地运行命令（关闭即停止，& 结尾转后台）。中英双语界面。

dshhub.summary: Open the current session's workspace in any detected IDE, terminal, or file manager; copy its path; run commands in a header-unfolded quick terminal. One folder button and one >_ button in every session header.

author: bitslicer
